class.name: OSShell
class.brief_description: The OpenDust OS window manager shown on a device screen.
class.description: A status bar (clock, transient notifications, signed-in name, world id, back button) above a content area that shows one app at a time. Built procedurally; a device works with no project assets. Apps are instantiated through the [OSKernel] app registry and receive an [OSAppContext].

method.name: open_app
method.description: Closes the current app and opens [param app_id].

method.name: notify
method.description: Shows [param text] in the status bar for a few seconds.

method.name: get_host
method.description: The [Device] or [Device2D] this shell belongs to.
